hack.root_cause: Tick Manipulation + Double Liquidity Counting — Precision Arithmetic Edge Case
hack.description: A highly sophisticated attacker exploited a sub-0.00000000001% precision error in KyberSwap Elastic's tick-crossing logic to double-count liquidity and drain $48M across 6 chains simultaneously — leaving step-by-step commentary in on-chain event logs.
